config.ordering: engines round-robin within each repetition; the starting engine rotates every repetition

cm-A.name: cm-A

limits.timeoutMs: enforced by Rust; one absolute deadline that includes bridge and Deno startup
limits.maxCalls: enforced by Rust; the first call beyond the allowance is rejected and ends the run
limits.concurrency: enforced by Rust's rolling scheduler (8, or 4 for codemode-c4)
limits.maxOutputBytes: enforced by Rust; shared budget for tool replies and final output (default 262144, set to 1048576 here); separately, each frame to the Deno guest is capped at 64 KiB

cm-A.shim: none in the guest; host shim maps bridge calls to tool functions and errors to {code, message}
